decisions.reason: The sourceability impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY establishing the optional main-board connector policy.
The ordering impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.
The connector assembly and ordering policy does not change required connector-pin markings.
Allowing optional connectors to remain unassembled does not change the orientation-validation requirement for assembled components.
The decision concerns optional connector procurement and assembly, not the required PCB production export files.
The source does not identify the charge-status connector or alter the required external charge-status output circuit.
The connectors remain part of the design, so the assembly policy does not alter their required PCB placement or orientation.
The source decision is limited to optional ESP32-adjacent main-board connectors and does not change the sensor-board connector matrix.
Leaving optional connectors unassembled does not change the three-board architecture or the defined roles of the boards.
The optional connector assembly policy does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable constraints.
The source does not change the required interboard power topology, connector specification, or pin behavior.
The optional main-board connector assembly policy does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting, clearances, or connector placement.
